declarations.description:
A phone number field: a country picker (flag and calling code) next to the national number, the sign-up field of
Stripe and Twilio. The value is the number in **E.164** (`+33612345678`), whatever the user typed: the national
number as written in the country (`06 12 34 56 78`, trunk prefix included), spaces, dashes or brackets. The field
groups the digits as the user types, in the country's usual layout.

Typing or pasting a number that starts with `+` picks its country from the calling code (and the area code, for
codes several countries share, such as +1 or +44). Setting `value` does the same; a `value` without `+` is read as a
national number of the current country.

`country` is the country selected when there is no value; without it, the region of `locale` (or the browser's
language) is used, then the United States. `countries` restricts the picker, `preferred-countries` lists a few at
the top. With a single country in `countries` the picker is replaced by a fixed flag and calling code, for a form
that only accepts numbers of one country; a `+` number of another country is then reported as invalid. Country names come from `Intl.DisplayNames` in `locale`.

The element is form-associated: the E.164 value is submitted under `name`. `required` reports an empty field, and a
number whose length the country's numbering plan does not allow is reported as invalid (`validity.patternMismatch`);
`valid` tells the same from script. The host exposes `:state(open)`, `:state(invalid)` (a number was typed but is
not possible), `:state(focus-within)` and `:state(disabled)`.

members.name: value
members.description:
The number in E.164 (`+33612345678`), or an empty string. Setting a value with `+` picks its country; a value
without `+` is a national number of the current country. Setting the attribute after the user has typed no
longer updates it, like a native input.

members.name: country
members.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code of the selected country (`FR`). Without it: the region of `locale`, then `US`.

members.name: countries
members.description: The countries the picker offers, as ISO codes. Empty offers all of them. As an attribute, separated by semicolons.

members.name: preferredCountries
members.description: Countries listed first in the picker, in this order. As an attribute, separated by semicolons.

members.name: locale
members.description: Locale of the country names, and of the default country. Defaults to the browser's language.

members.name: placeholder
members.description: Text shown while the number is empty. Defaults to an example number of the selected country.

members.name: ariaLabel
members.description: Accessible name of the number field. Defaults to "Phone number".

members.name: searchLabel
members.description: Placeholder and accessible name of the country search field.

members.name: emptyLabel
members.description: Shown when no country matches the search.

members.name: name
members.description: Form field name: the E.164 number is submitted with the form under this name.

members.name: required
members.description: An empty number makes the form invalid.

members.name: disabled
members.description: Disables the number field and the country picker.

members.name: readonly
members.description: The number can be selected and submitted but not edited; the country picker is disabled.

members.name: digits
members.description: The national number's digits as typed, trunk prefix included.

members.name: pendingText
members.description: What the number field shows while a `+` number is being typed whose calling code is not complete yet.

members.name: form
members.description: The containing form, when this control is associated with one.

members.name: labels
members.description: Labels associated with this form control.

members.name: dialCode
members.description: The calling code of the selected country, without the plus (`33`).

members.name: nationalNumber
members.description: The national significant number: the digits after the calling code, without the trunk prefix.

members.name: valid
members.description: Whether the number is empty or has a length the selected country's numbering plan allows.

members.name: select
members.description: Selects the whole number.

members.name: allowedCountries
members.description: The countries the picker offers, in data order.

members.name: currentCountry
members.description: The selected country: the chosen one if allowed, else the locale's region, else the first allowed country.

members.name: options
members.description: The picker's options: the preferred countries, then every allowed country by name, filtered by the search.

members.name: parseValue
members.description: The country and national digits a value stands for.

members.name: applyValue
members.description: Reads a value into the country and the national digits.

members.name: handleBeforeInput
members.description: Deleting a space or bracket deletes the digit beside it, so the regrouping does not put the character back.

members.name: formatted
members.description: The number field's text.

members.name: scrollActiveIntoView
members.description: Scrolls the country list only: `scrollIntoView` would scroll every ancestor, the page included.

events.name: country-change
events.description: The selected country changed, from the picker or from a typed or pasted `+` prefix. Does not bubble; listen on the element.

events.name: input
events.description: Re-dispatched from the number field on every keystroke; also fired when a country is picked and the value changes.

events.name: change
events.description: Re-dispatched from the number field when the number is committed; also fired when a country is picked and the value changes.
